//Adder: The adder's roll, in the heron's shape (hw_tgr_heron.json) with ONE ACTION PER PLACE: a counter stat, a weighted Nothing-versus-Event ProducedCards, an event card the player clicks. It spawns hw_event_adder (a bite wound and a few hours of venom); this file only decides WHETHER an adder strikes. ALL GATES ARE StatChangeTrigger ENTRIES, never RequiredStatValues: an unresolved trigger stat never fires (fails closed) while an unresolved RequiredStatValues stat is skipped (fails open), As_Built 4.2. Gate 1, hw_switch_adder {1,1}: 0 (the [Threats] Adder switch off) can never fire it. Gate 2, SeasonCounter_Summer {1,2880} (vanilla GUID 4a9284146ffc28242b1f591ac7f7541f): the counter runs 1 to 2880 through summer and reads 0 outside it. Gate 3, Sheltered {0,0} (vanilla GUID e2031c58efb4cb84fa95a3a813513dae): the player is outdoors. Gate 4, hw_clock_daylight {1,1}: the hour is 09:00 to 17:45. Gate 5, hw_adder_clock {192,192}: the cooldown has climbed to its max (ADDER_COOLDOWN_TICKS 192 = 2 days) and, because the grace is the clock's own negative start (ADDER_GRACE_TICKS 480 = 5 days), nothing fires in the first 5 days. RepeatOptions 2 (ResetWhenOutOfRange) with each action's own reset of the clock by -192 makes each firing one roll. PLACES (W0-4, Documentation/Research/HarshWilds/wave0-threats.md section 2): the current environment's own CT8 location card satisfies RequiredCardsOnBoard (MEASURED from GameManager.CardIsOnBoardScan, live vanilla precedent Tgr_HagPondFear), and entries are ANDed, so 'any of these places' is one action per place, each with a single CT8 entry. 24 places: 12 open clearings (Clearing*, 'open'; four of them heather or meadow) and 12 rocky or sloped places (Grove and Thicket cards whose names and help text read rocky, sloped or mountain). The CLASSIFICATION by place is INFERRED from card names and help text (the export carries no open, rocky or heath flag), and the live half of W0-4 (Prompt 5) is not yet run. Caves, river banks, lake banks and wet clearings are left out; there is no place-class tag route (no card carries tag_EnvOpen). Roll, the same in every action: Nothing has weight ADDER_NOTHING_WEIGHT 80; Adder has base weight ADDER_WEIGHT 20 and two StatsDropChanceModifiers: FootProtection (GUID 384d7070fef781a40aba1f0f16dd5fa6, 0 to 10) lowers it by up to 14 and LegProtection (GUID 5bc13600b838a4742a409339e11b9661, 0 to 10) by up to 6, interpolated across the range, never below 0 in total (14 plus 6 equals the base). Vanilla Leather Shoes write FootProtection 8 (Bark Sandals 5), so shoes lower the weight from 20 to about 8; LegProtection is written only by NOT_USED_ vanilla cards (W0-14), so it reads 0 in real play and its row is inert today (kept because it is harmless and future-proof; README does not promise leg protection). Bare-footed, the odds are 20 in 100 per roll, one roll at most every 2 days of daylight outdoors in a listed place in summer. Every number here is a TUNABLE PLACEHOLDER, session-inferred and unmeasured against play, never balanced.
